craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Shattered-skull borne-waking; You-show close. Rejected: (a) shattered→broken → killed: shattered scatters. Read aloud: FAME-less-FORMED … THUS-you-SHOW.

lines: there, by supreme waking borne — thus You show.
l4.sanskrit_cite: akhyātirūpam asamaṃ māyāyāḥ śakalitaṃ śiro 'traitat parabodhamayena mayā muṇḍaṃ bibhrat prakāśayasy evam

reads_against.argmap: What skull shows waking? → Māyā-head shattered; skull borne shown waking.
c1_essence: Taken rest in mass; pretext commands.
